newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile stocks end lower in token turnover.
newsitem.headline: Chile stocks end lower in token turnover.

text.p: Bucking Wall Street's surge, Chilean blue chips closed softer in thin volume with fertilizer maker Soquimich among the few heavyweight gainers, said traders.
The bolsa is expected to open steady, but investors are seen staying on the sidelines unless there is some market-moving news, they said.
The 40-share index ended down 0.11 percent at 120.47 points. The general index shed 0.18 percent at 5,379.12 points in turnover of 5.9 billion pesos.
"The turnover was very low, as is usual for Monday, but in addition there were few institutional investors," said one dealer.
Despite the Dow's rally, there was very little interest among foreign investors for Chilean-issued American Depositary Receipts, they said.
The exception was Soquimich which rose on demand abroad with associated company Nortegrand climbing in tandem, they added.
Soquimich ended up 1.76 percent at 2,600 pesos. Other winners included steel-maker Cap which rallied 1.79 percent to 1,140 pesos.
Losers included copper products firm Madeco, down 3.06 percent at 1,110 pesos and forestry company Masisa, which fell 2.08 percent to 235 pesos.
